Package jimpossiblemission.controller.game

Class LevelManager

java.lang.Object
java.util.Observable
jimpossiblemission.controller.game.LevelManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observer
public class LevelManager extends Observable implements Observer
Level Manager (Singleton) is used to create levels. Every level contains all kind of gameObject (excluded Player) static and dynamic. Level Manager has a main Elevator to move player between floors. Also it manages all kind of keys used in game.
Author:
Filippo Taiuti
